# Faceless Video Kit

> A download that plugs into Claude or ChatGPT on your Mac or PC and makes faceless YouTube videos and Shorts. You pick the topics; your AI assistant writes the script and makes the voice, pictures, captions, thumbnail and a finished MP4, cuts up to 5 Shorts, and posts only when you say yes. Not a web app.

- Who it's for: people who want a faceless YouTube channel without a camera, a mic, editing skills or typing commands.
- How it works: setup takes about 15 minutes and your AI assistant does it. A local Studio page shows every video. Autopilot makes videos under a weekly spending limit you set.
- Styles: 12 looks including photo-real, 3D cartoon, fantasy, stick figures, archival film and stock footage. Long videos and Shorts.
- Posting: YouTube, plus Shorts to TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook and Threads, each after your yes.
- What else you pay for: pictures, clips and voice come from the AI services the Kit has built in (ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, OpenAI (ChatGPT’s image model and voices), Google Veo, fal.ai or Fish Audio) or your own files; research can also come through vidIQ or NexLev connected to your AI assistant; the Kit shows each price before spending. Research and stock footage are free. Claude's free plan works; ChatGPT needs a paid plan.
- Price: Starter $29/month (1 channel), Pro $49/month (unlimited channels) or Lifetime $199 once (unlimited channels). 7-day refund, no questions.
- Earnings: not promised. Results depend on niche, posting and YouTube's rules.
